2. Data, scenarios and purposes

We process the following information for the features you use. Login, cloud processing and subscription verification require acceptance of this policy. You may decline and skip login to use local records. The entries below describe the source, purpose, processing method and retention of each category.

Digital Vouchers (currently Work Hours Confirmation): when the feature is available and you choose to create a work hours confirmation, the app uploads the selected project, equipment, dates, work content and hours as a confirmation snapshot over HTTPS, together with the issuing account ID and contact information you enter. The purpose is to show and confirm work content and hours with external recipients you select, keep a confirmation audit, generate a PDF and link corrections. It does not confirm rates, amounts, receivables, debts, settlement or payment. Snapshots, confirmation audits and correction chains are stored on the developer's Alibaba Cloud servers in mainland China; PDFs are held in object storage in mainland China. The app may keep local records and temporary downloaded files.

Recipients: you send a link or PDF to external recipients through the system share sheet or another sharing method. A person holding a valid link can view the document and, after reviewing the project, equipment, dates, work content and hours, directly confirm or sign as selected by the sender. Links may be forwarded; possession does not verify the person's real identity or authority to act for someone else. The confirmation audit records the confirmation method and time, confirmed snapshot digest, statement version, and hashes of the IP address and browser information to trace the confirmation action. Once confirmed, the original content cannot be edited in place; the issuer must create a correction document, retaining the link between the original and corrections, the reason and confirmation status. A PDF is a downloadable, shareable document copy.

Signature confirmation: when a recipient submits a handwritten signature on a Work Hours Confirmation after checking the consent box, the service collects the handwritten signature image, signing time, IP address and user agent (browser information) as evidence of that confirmation. The retained signature image is only visible to the sender through authenticated account access, including the sender’s app confirmation document and PDF copies. The sender may choose to share PDF copies containing the signature. Holders of a valid link can view the confirmation status and time, but the link does not provide the retained signature image. Immediately after signing, the recipient can see the locally captured preview on that page. Signature evidence follows the same retention and deletion rules as the document’s confirmation audit, described in section 7.

Confirmation snapshots, confirmation audits, signature images and server-held PDFs follow the shared retention rules in section 7. Unconfirmed, expired and voided documents are kept for 7 days and then deleted automatically; all signed documents (direct confirmation, SMS verification, handwritten signature and missing or unknown confirmation methods) and their complete correction chains are kept permanently and deleted only when you delete them or delete your account. Retention is not linked to settlement. For an unconfirmed voucher whose link has expired, seven days starts at link expiry; for an expired voucher, at expiry; and for a voided voucher, at voiding.

Core Usage Analytics: after you agree to this policy, successful creation of work hours, payments, fuel, maintenance or Digital Vouchers by a signed-in account sends daily Beijing-time feature markers and only five environment fields (platform, brand, phone model, OS major version and app display version) to our own server. This supports core-operation activity, D1/D7 retention and compatibility analysis, including free accounts. We do not upload amounts, hours, customers, projects, user-named equipment, notes or voucher content, read your phone’s custom name, unique device or advertising identifiers, or record opens, views, operation counts or heartbeats. Environment combinations are stored separately and account-linked identities are deduplicated for totals; combinations are not phone counts. Signed-out operations or periods without an accepted privacy policy are not collected or backfilled. Analytics is on after you agree to this policy. Withdrawing privacy consent (available at any time under Devices → Settings → Withdraw Privacy Policy Consent) makes the app stop collection immediately and clears pending analytics records of all accounts on this device; analytics details already received by the server are not deleted immediately and are automatically deleted after at most 90 Beijing calendar days, counted by the analytics date. Daily details are kept for the most recent 90 Beijing calendar days including today; reports accept today and the preceding 7 calendar days. Older origins are compressed to a “before window” state without dates or environment fields, without permanent environment profiles; after privacy-consent withdrawal, this “before window” origin record and any analytics consent record left by earlier versions are not removed by the 90-day cleanup and are kept until account deletion. After account deletion is accepted, the server deletes this account’s analytics details and origin in the deletion process without waiting for the 90-day expiry (failures are retried and completion is within the 30-calendar-day deletion period in section 7), and recalculates retention.

3. Permissions and system features

Photos: when you choose a device avatar, the system picker returns the selected image. iOS may request photo access; manage it under Settings → FleetLedger → Photos. Android uses the system picker without requesting access to all photos or all files. Denial leaves default avatars and bookkeeping available.

Files and sharing: user-initiated import, export and sharing use the system picker or share sheet. You choose the recipient, who controls the shared copy.

Network: Android INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE support consented network features. They do not authorize access to contacts, SMS or location.

This edition does not request contacts, location, microphone, SMS-reading or camera permissions. The app itself does not read IMEI or advertising identifiers for tracking. You enter verification codes manually. Store reviews, email and browser links open only on your action.

Local Flutter storage and file-picker plugins do not receive permission to upload business records to their authors.

System sharing hands the content you select to your chosen app, which handles it under its own policy.

5. Storage locations and international processing

The business database and selected avatars are initially stored on your device. For editions distributed in mainland China, Hong Kong and Macao, our account, cloud sync and IAP subscription verification data is stored in SQLite on Alibaba Cloud ECS in Chengdu (cn-chengdu). Cloud backup objects are stored in Hangzhou OSS; Work Hours Confirmation objects, including PDFs, are stored in Chengdu OSS. When users in Hong Kong or Macao use these network features, the relevant data is sent to mainland China servers.

These storage locations do not describe every third party’s processing. Account SMS uses the Alibaba Cloud DYPNS server API; Work Hours Confirmation SMS is currently off. The SMS provider handles information under its applicable terms and policies. GitHub Pages hosts the support site. GitHub logs visitor IP addresses and other access information and may process it in the US. The app passes no account or ledger parameters when opening the fixed support URL. Company email developer@yuyuan.net.cn uses Alibaba Cloud enterprise mail, stored in China. QQ Mail 582748196@qq.com is provided by Tencent and handled under its own policy.

iOS uses App Store / StoreKit. Our IAP backend sends transaction IDs to api.storekit.apple.com to query subscription status, involving cross-border processing by recipients including Apple Inc. (US) and Apple Distribution International (Ireland), under Apple’s privacy policy. This subscription query does not upload the ledger. The app does not integrate Sign in with Apple, APNs or iCloud. See section 4 for providers and privacy policies.

The app has used TestFlight for beta testing. During beta testing, tester email addresses and crash/diagnostic data are processed by Apple and may be processed outside mainland China, under Apple’s TestFlight & Privacy notice and privacy policy.

https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/en/test-flight/

https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/en-ww/

Self-hosted core usage analytics is processed with our account service on Alibaba Cloud servers in mainland China.

6. Security

Production account and backup endpoints require HTTPS. Login tokens use system secure storage. Servers validate identity and isolate account data. Cloud backups use client-side encryption and require the corresponding key for restoration. Application diagnostic logs redact phone numbers, tokens and subscription identifiers.

The local business database is not an end-to-end encrypted database. Device access, system backups and exported files also affect security. Protect your device and exports. We will investigate personal-information incidents, take remedial action and notify affected users as required.

7. Retention and deletion

Category-specific retention is listed in section 2. Signing out or uninstalling does not delete server data or cancel a store subscription.

Unconfirmed, expired and voided Digital Vouchers (currently Work Hours Confirmation) are kept for 7 days and then deleted automatically. For unconfirmed documents, the clock starts at creation; for unconfirmed documents whose link has expired and for expired documents, at link expiry; and for voided documents, at the voiding time. Seven days means 604800 elapsed seconds in UTC. A document becomes eligible for automatic cleanup only at or after its applicable deadline. An unconfirmed document whose link is still valid seven days after creation is held and its valid link is never deleted early under this rule. Once the link expires, the seven-day clock is recalculated from link expiry.

All signed (confirmed) documents are kept permanently and deleted only when you delete them or delete your account, including direct confirmation, SMS verification, handwritten signature and historical documents with missing or unknown confirmation methods. Link expiry, failed PDF generation or replacement by a correction does not change that rule. Every explicitly linked complete correction chain is also kept indefinitely, including unconfirmed, expired and voided members and unsuccessful correction branches. Indefinite retention is subject to your active deletion requests, including account deletion, through existing procedures. Voiding a document does not delete it. Retention is not linked to settlement.

Missing or invalid seven-day starting times, contradictory confirmation evidence, unknown document states, and correction chains with missing links, cycles or cross-account links are held for review. Accounts undergoing deletion, already deleted or with an unverified account state are also excluded from seven-day cleanup; the existing account-deletion process, deadlines and link rules remain as set out below. Confirmation snapshots, confirmation audits, signature images and server-held PDFs follow the same rule as their document.

Logging in counts as agreeing to the current privacy policy. You can withdraw privacy consent at any time under Devices → Settings → Withdraw Privacy Policy Consent; declining when an updated policy is shown also withdraws it. After withdrawal, the app immediately stops collection, clears pending analytics records of all accounts on this device and signs you out; your local ledger stays, and you must agree to this policy again before logging in or using network features. Analytics details already received by the server are not deleted immediately and are automatically deleted after at most 90 days; the compressed “before window” origin record and any analytics consent record left by earlier versions are kept until account deletion. Account deletion deletes this account’s analytics details immediately. After login, use Devices → Account Center → Account Management → Delete Account to verify identity and submit a request, or contact section 13. The account-deletion period is 30 calendar days after identity verification and acceptance of the deletion request, covering account, backup, sync, subscription-linked data and Digital Vouchers (currently Work Hours Confirmation). Our own IAP records are kept while the account exists and deleted on account deletion; Apple retains its own purchase records under its policy. SMS verification and abuse-prevention records and access and security logs are retained for their respective purposes and deleted when those purposes end; the 30 calendar days do not apply to them. Account migration backups follow the existing 29-day technical cleanup rule.

Once deletion starts, the old login cannot create, share or confirm digital vouchers, generate or download PDFs, or create corrections. Digital Voucher links already sent that are still valid and not voided when deletion is accepted remain available for recipients to view or confirm until D - 1 day (86400 seconds). Links expire immediately at D - 86400 seconds, where D is the deadline of the same 30-calendar-day account-deletion period. Snapshots, confirmation audits (including signature images, signing times, IP addresses and user agents as signature evidence), server-held PDFs and the complete correction chain are removed together with account deletion. The indefinite-retention and seven-day rules above do not change this active account-deletion process. Already expired or voided links are not restored.

You and recipients manage PDFs, screenshots and other copies already downloaded, exported, forwarded or saved. The developer cannot remotely delete or recall those copies by deleting server records or invalidating links.

After identity verification and acceptance of a cloud-data deletion request, we complete deletion within 15 days. Account deletion and its linked data follow the 30-calendar-day account-deletion process in section 7.

Core Usage Analytics: after you agree to this policy, successful creation of work hours, payments, fuel, maintenance or Digital Vouchers by a signed-in account sends daily Beijing-time feature markers and only five environment fields (platform, brand, phone model, OS major version and app display version) to our own server. This supports core-operation activity, D1/D7 retention and compatibility analysis, including free accounts. We do not upload amounts, hours, customers, projects, user-named equipment, notes or voucher content, read your phone’s custom name, unique device or advertising identifiers, or record opens, views, operation counts or heartbeats. Daily details are kept for the most recent 90 Beijing calendar days including today; reports accept today and the preceding 7 calendar days. 8. Access, correction, copies and deletion

Access and correction: view and edit your entries on device, work-hour, fuel, maintenance and project-account pages. View account information in Account Center.

Copies: use available exports, or request a personal-information copy by company email free of charge, even if a local-backup feature requires a paid plan.

Deletion: delete your business entries on their respective pages. Request Digital Voucher, cloud and account data deletion through account deletion or email. Contact us to change a login phone number or information you cannot edit yourself. A paid plan is not required to exercise these rights.

We verify only the identity information needed for the request, report the outcome and explain requests we cannot fulfill.

After identity verification and acceptance of a cloud-data deletion request, we complete deletion within 15 days. Account deletion and its linked data follow the 30-calendar-day account-deletion process in section 7.

10. Minors

FleetLedger is intended for construction-equipment business management, not children, especially those under 14. Minors should use it with guardian guidance and also contact us by email. Guardians who find child information processed without their consent should contact the company email so we can verify and stop processing or delete it.

11. Policy changes

New purposes, services or channel capabilities require updated policy and store disclosures. A changed consent scope triggers a new in-app notice; acceptance of an older policy is not automatically treated as acceptance of the new version. You may decline and continue with local features.
